label: Top of Well
literalRoomDescription: You are at the top of the well. Well done. There are etchings on the side of the well. There is a small crack across the floor at the entrance to a room on the east, but it can be crossed easily.
safeSceneProfile: Top of well with side etchings and easily crossed floor crack at eastern room entrance. No invented fatal crack or guessed sky.
